changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE comment ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, post_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, content VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, parent_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '一级评论为 0', top_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '所属一级评论', reply_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '一级评论的回复数', deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_comment_post (post_id, top_id, created_time), KEY idx_comment_top (top_id, created_time), KEY idx_comment_user (user_id) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '评论';
